svg.title: Freezing droplets: preparation, measured X-ray front, CT and Raman
svg.desc: The source and light-green detector are schematic. All radiographs, CT cross-sections and Raman panels are original experimental figure excerpts, not redrawn data.

g.text: Freezing water and aqueous PVA droplets

svg.title: Cool a solution droplet from below
svg.desc: A water or aqueous PVA droplet rests on a temperature-controlled substrate. Heat is extracted downward through the stage. The drawing represents the preparation for bottom-up freezing.

svg.title: Watch an ice front rise through a freezing water droplet
svg.desc: An original X-ray radiograph at 28 seconds shows liquid water above an advancing ice front and bubble-containing ice below. The source, beam paths and light-green detector around that measured image are schematic. Original radiograph: Im et al., arXiv:2511.20571v1, Fig. 1(e).

image.aria-label: Original X-ray radiograph: liquid above the ice front, frozen ice and bubbles below, at 28 seconds

g.text: Ice grows upward from the cooled substrate
Schematic detector: light green. Original image data and labels are not redrawn.
CT contrast does not identify local phase; Raman color shows relative intensity, not absolute PVA concentration.
Original panels: Im et al., arXiv:2511.20571v1, Fig. 1; PVA droplet manuscript Fig. 3; ICE 2025 poster.
